verdict.rationale: Cloud Agents run in cloud VMs that do not need the local machine to stay connected. They can be started or managed from iOS, from cursor.com/agents on any device, from Desktop, or from Slack, which implies a task begun in one place can be picked up elsewhere. However, no evidence explicitly documents handing off a session from one device to another or resuming the same task later. missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-device session continuation or handoff (e.g., local-to-cloud or desktop-to-web resume), hands-on corroboration of continuing a task from another device.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start a task on one device and continue it later from another device or browser

citations.quote: can be kicked off from iOS, cursor.com/agents on any device (Android PWA), Desktop, Slack (@cursor), GitHub/Bitbucket PR comments, Linear, or the API
You can run as many agents as you want in parallel, and they do not require your local machine to be connected to the internet.
runs need to survive the caller disconnecting
